page.overview:
Who is Bath Boy Gang?

In the Distant Lands episode, "Together Again", it was revealed that three of the Bath Boy gang members had ended up in the 1st Dead World.

One of the three unknown members of the gang wears hair curlers and a white swimsuit. The pointy-eared one wears briefs and red bath slippers, and both hold exfoliating stones. The tallest one has green skin and wears a white towel and blue hairnet.
